_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 26: early July 2025, completing everything to 2025-09-30. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what the massive system on NASA's website is, says most people assume it will not affect us, and states that he believes it will.
mentions.quote: What is this massive system that they're talking about on NASA's website?
mentions.falsify_match: An astronomical body affecting the earth.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the distinction between what can be avoided and what cannot, and says the Lord told them to pray on the Fourth of July and stop the men who are trying to do this.
mentions.quote: that's why he said pray on the 4th of July. Stop these men
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on 4 July 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a word that the working of miracles and the full orbit shall be manifested in a measure no one has ever seen, that it shall come to pass this year and at last, and that what has hindered shall be taken out of the way.
mentions.quote: It shall come to pass this year. It shall come to pass at last
mentions.falsify_match: An unprecedented and documented run of miracles during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him they must pray over the midterms for a great victory, because 2026 would try to be a fix and they would try to fix things.
mentions.quote: 2026 would try to be a a fix. They would try to fix things
mentions.falsify_match: Electoral manipulation in the 2026 midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: A clean midterm, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He dates a formative morning to 1 July 1985, a Monday at about seven in the morning, when he would park for privacy, read his Bible and walk the track praying.
mentions.quote: that morning, July the 1st, 1985, that Monday morning at about 7 a.m.
mentions.falsify_match: 1 July 1985 was indeed a Monday, which is checkable and correct.

mentions.claim_text: He says the plagues and the things the Lord shows him are coming to pass so quickly because time is becoming shorter, that Christ is standing at the door, and to watch the acceleration.
mentions.quote: we're seeing it all come to to pass so quickly
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an assertion that the words are landing, with no case named.

mentions.claim_text: He describes people crawling out because the glory showed up at meetings held in a rented room in a casino.
mentions.quote: the glory showed up and they were holding meetings in the casino
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unattributed report of a meeting.

mentions.claim_text: He says the elites know something is coming, see it in outer space and on the earth, are scared and preparing, and hold the view that others may die but they will not.
mentions.quote: you all may die, but we're not becau
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of elite survival preparation tied to an astronomical threat.

mentions.claim_text: He says you will see darkness like never before, gross darkness, and points at hearing in the near future about de-extincted animals going into zoos such as a woolly mammoth.
mentions.quote: Hey, we got a woolly mammoth
mentions.falsify_match: A de-extincted mammoth or similar displayed in a zoo.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord repeatedly telling him people do not realise how truly bad the tribulation will be, and that it will be hell on earth.
mentions.quote: people do not realize how truly bad tribulation is going to be
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a claim about a future period with no date.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a pool of people who will refuse to vote with the Republicans because they are liberal, and repeats that the Lord said 2026 will be the year of a fix.
mentions.quote: the Lord said about midterms? 2026 will be the year of a fix
mentions.falsify_match: A fixed or heavily contested 2026 midterm.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must pray for what is coming with the midterms because it is a very serious time, that in 2026 they are going to try to fix it, and refers back to the rat in the White House he warned about.
mentions.quote: 2026, the Lord said they're going to try to fix it
mentions.falsify_match: Interference in the 2026 midterms.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to pray against a Democratic governor over the state for 2026 in Oklahoma, because they will try to do it, and that some of what he saw coming was interesting.
mentions.quote: not a Democratic uh governor over your nation, over your state uh for 2026
mentions.falsify_match: A Democrat winning the Oklahoma governorship in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The seat stays Republican, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He quotes the Lord asking what he will do with this three years given him, notes it was three and a half or four years back then, and says the window is for bringing in the harvest as the shmita cycle starts.
mentions.quote: Three and a half years, four years back then
mentions.falsify_match: He acknowledges the window has shrunk from four years to three and dates the change himself.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that men's hearts will fail them for fear at what is coming on the earth because the powers of the heavens shall be shaken, says they will be humbled, and refers back to another preacher's video.
mentions.quote: men's hearts will fail them for fear, looking after those things that are coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scripture applied to the present.

mentions.claim_text: He says the experience lasted all night, was the most amazing and life changing of his life, that everything is still real to him and he sees it as it was ten years ago on 6 July 2014.
mentions.quote: July the 6th of 2014, I had
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the founding experience, restated on its anniversary.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a white building with a lot of glass moving back and forth, and links it to a retribution he saw coming for African-American people and a baby being birthed.
mentions.quote: a retribution coming for the African-American people
mentions.falsify_match: A reckoning or restitution event involving African-Americans.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though the content is left vague.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the 14th of July and that Ripple has said it is applying for a bank charter, saying all of this stems off the new BBB and that they are going to make crypto great.
mentions.quote: Ripple comes out and says hey we're going to be we're applying for a bank
mentions.falsify_match: The bank charter application is a matter of public record, so this is commentary rather than foresight.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that politicians, law enforcement, homeland security and the FBI be given ideas and downloads from the Holy Spirit so they wake in the midnight hour and know.
mentions.quote: GIVE THEM THE THE DOWNLOADS FROM THE HOLY SPIRIT
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a thwarted plot and no plot are indistinguishable.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying I am going to restore back what the cankerworm ate, repeats that supernatural finances are coming to the people, and says he saw a baby being born again and saw Israel.
mentions.quote: I'M GOING TO RESTORE BACK WHAT THE CANKERWORM ATE
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private restoration over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: Sign off wishing viewers a happy Fourth of July, blessing America and noting 249 years.
mentions.quote: Happy 4th of July, ladies and gentlemen. God bless America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign off.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer over what happens going into the fourth quarter and over the acceleration of the wealth of the wicked laid up for the righteous, through a window running July, August, September, October and November into the first of the year.
mentions.quote: going in for the for the window through July, August, September, October, and November
mentions.time_phrase: July through the first of the year
mentions.falsify_match: A visible transfer of wealth across that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will come when you are not expecting it and will be a Pearl Harbor experience, that everybody is expecting the Fourth of July which is why he has not made it all about that, and that he still feels caution about lone wolf attacks.
mentions.quote: It's going to be a Pearl Harbor experience. Everybody's expecting the Fourth of July
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise mass casualty attack on American soil.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though by design it carries no date.

mentions.claim_text: He encourages people to enjoy the Fourth of July but keep their antennas up, in America and around the world, because a great shaking to awaken is coming and he can sense it in the air.
mentions.quote: Keep your antennas up. If you're in America, keep your antennas up
mentions.falsify_match: A worldwide shaking event.

mentions.claim_text: Closing prayer over everyone represented, with a note that they will do a live stream and pray more.
mentions.quote: We'll do a live stream and we'll pray more
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: closing prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says again in his spirit that there will be a Pearl Harbor experience, calls for prayer about lone wolf attacks, and says he hears the word sympathizers, people who are enthusiastic sympathisers rising up.
mentions.quote: I hear the word sympathizers are going to try to rise up
mentions.falsify_match: Lone wolf attacks in the US by sympathisers of a foreign cause.
